_comment: The shape of the React/Vite app, as data. Two tools read this file and nothing else:
scripts/check-structure.mjs enforces the filesystem shape (naming, colocation, orphan CSS),
and eslint.config.js turns `layers` into no-restricted-imports rules. Change the app's shape
here, once, and both gates follow — do not hand-edit the rules in either consumer.
_layers: A module may import from its own directory or from a strictly lower rank, never sideways and
never upward. Rank 0 is a leaf that knows nothing about the app above it. A new feature
directory has to be given a rank here before it will pass FE008.
_assetDirs: Directories holding no importable modules of their own: stylesheets and test setup.
_lowerCaseTsx: The .tsx files that are not components, and so are not PascalCase.
